design_answers.temporal_only_reason: The 33-record old time bucket contained quantity limits, legal references, manner, other scope and overlap-only fragments. Corrected review finds time as an any-label in a minority of the 52 records; legal reference, quantity, purpose, manner, other and overlap-only cases are also present. A temporal-only candidate would target only a subset and would not address time-like FPs such as only for part of the calendar year, prior/by official notice, or before an annual adjustment.
design_answers.main_failure_pattern: No single failure mode dominates. The evidence supports a mixture of (a) partial recovery / long-Gold overlap and scope problems, (b) isolated cue-only and cross-field duplication FPs, (c) span replacement as well as net FP increase, and (d) observed actor spillover/instability. This is not primarily a clean type-selection failure that one temporal/guard edit would fix.
design_answers.why_not_enough: The panel is single-run, development/exploratory, with no pre-registered success threshold or held-out blind test. A candidate would need to specify target semantic types, scope/completeness behavior, FP tolerances and actor-side guard, but the corrected evidence does not isolate which single change would improve net value. Running more arms without a frozen decision rule would only add calls, not identification.
